item.text: {"rule":"The procedure appears to guarantee B: after the first choice, it keeps whichever pair contains B (the petted pair if B was petted, otherwise the unpetted pair). After the second choice, it keeps B—if B is petted, B stays; otherwise the petted cat leaves."}
